patch_resolves_note: The switched fixed source adds `sanitize_records(c)` to `OT::name::sanitize()`. On the original staged PoC the fixed binary stays clean and never reaches `packed_map.set`, and on the constructive `count1_record0_name1_len1` witness the same fixed binary reaches `pack_set_any` with `records_valid=1`, showing the repair preserves the downstream path only when the per-record obligation is satisfied.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-side materialization of the attacker-controlled `name` table bytes on the crashing subset path.
The vulnerable sanitizer accepts the `name` table after only shallow header and array-range checks; it never dispatches `NameRecord::sanitize()` on each record against the string pool.
Exact MSAN crash site while `packed_map.set()` probes the deduplication hashmap for a serialized object whose bytes were copied from outside the `name` table.
The first selected invalid `NameRecord` on the vulnerable path is copied from the concrete out-of-range source pointer `src_base + offset` in `OT::NameRecord::copy()`.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `name_copy_selected.source_ptr = 0x71d0000019d8` for the selected malformed record.

nodes.description: The serializer's `UnsizedArrayOf<HBUINT8>::copy()` reads from the same selected out-of-range source pointer and materializes those bytes in the destination object buffer `out->arrayZ`.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `u8_copy_selected.source_ptr = 0x71d0000019d8` and `u8_copy_selected.dest_ptr = 0x718000000066`.

nodes.description: Intermediate runtime event pack_set_selected materialized from verified transition assertion A-SELECTED-U8-COPY-BUFFER-REACHES-PACK-SET.

edges.description: The exact out-of-range source pointer chosen in `OT::NameRecord::copy()` is the source pointer consumed by the downstream `UnsizedArrayOf<HBUINT8>::copy()` byte copy.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `name_copy_selected.source_ptr == u8_copy_selected.source_ptr == 0x71d0000019d8`.

edges.description: The destination object buffer produced by the selected `UnsizedArrayOf<HBUINT8>::copy()` call is the same object-head buffer that `hb_serialize_context_t::pop_pack()` presents to `packed_map.set()` for deduplication.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `u8_copy_selected.dest_ptr == pack_set_selected.obj_head_ptr == 0x718000000066`.
